title: Un petit trou pas cher
overview: "Un petit trou pas cher" is a French medium-length film directed by Pierre-Jean Ducis and released in 1934. This black-and-white fiction film, lasting approximately 40 minutes, stars actors Jules Berry, Julien Carette, and Léonce Corne. The plot follows a reveler who, pursued by creditors, decides to hole up in his own little "hole" to escape them.
